verdict.rationale: VLP's VC practice page says the firm regularly counsels venture capital funds, corporate VC groups, pooled investment vehicles and angel, seed and high-net-worth investors. The same page says it represents venture-backed and angel-backed startups and negotiates their financing documents, so it clearly works both sides of the table. Its knowledge of current market terms is only implied by this dual-side practice, not shown directly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of market-terms expertise (e.g., deal-terms surveys, benchmark data, or a published deal volume), independent or client corroboration of investor-side work, and detail on how the dual perspective is applied in company-side negotiations.
